sql:
/*
================================================================================
蜡笔小新繁体 - 开服当日实时小时 KPI
口径：累计新增、累计活跃、累计付费人数、累计流水；排除黑名单、沙盒和免费订单。
================================================================================
*/
WITH UserBlacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
ValidEvents AS (
    SELECT
        v."$part_date" AS stat_date,
        HOUR(CAST(v."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP)) AS event_hour,
        v."#user_id" AS user_id,
        v."#account_id" AS account_id,
        v."$part_event" AS event_name,
        CASE
            WHEN v."$part_event" = 'charge'
             AND (v.sandbox IS NULL OR v.sandbox = FALSE)
             AND (v.is_freebuy IS NULL OR v.is_freebuy = FALSE)
            THEN CAST(v.pay_amount AS DOUBLE) / COALESCE(x.exchange, 1)
            ELSE 0.0
        END AS revenue_usd
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist ub ON v."#user_id" = ub.user_id
    LEFT JOIN ta_dim.ta_exchange x
      ON v."$part_date" = x.ex_date
     AND v.pay_currency = x.currency
    WHERE v."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-07-29'
      AND v."$part_event" IN ('new_role', 'login', 'charge')
      AND ub.user_id IS NULL
      AND (
          v."$part_event" <> 'charge'
          OR (
              (v.sandbox IS NULL OR v.sandbox = FALSE)
              AND (v.is_freebuy IS NULL OR v.is_freebuy = FALSE)
          )
      )
),
ObservedHours AS (
    SELECT stat_date, hour_value AS stat_hour
    FROM (
        SELECT stat_date, MAX(event_hour) AS max_hour
        FROM ValidEvents
        GROUP BY 1
    ) d
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(SEQUENCE(0, d.max_hour)) AS t(hour_value)
),
FirstUserHour AS (
    SELECT
        stat_date,
        user_id,
        MIN(CASE WHEN event_name = 'new_role' THEN event_hour END) AS new_hour,
        MIN(CASE WHEN event_name = 'login' THEN event_hour END) AS login_hour,
        MIN(CASE WHEN event_name = 'charge' THEN event_hour END) AS pay_hour
    FROM ValidEvents
    WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
RevenueByHour AS (
    SELECT stat_date, event_hour, SUM(revenue_usd) AS revenue_usd
    FROM ValidEvents
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
HourlyUserAgg AS (
    SELECT
        h.stat_date,
        h.stat_hour,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.new_hour <= h.stat_hour THEN u.user_id END) AS cumulative_new_users,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.login_hour <= h.stat_hour THEN u.user_id END) AS cumulative_active_users,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.pay_hour <= h.stat_hour THEN u.user_id END) AS cumulative_payers
    FROM ObservedHours h
    LEFT JOIN FirstUserHour u ON h.stat_date = u.stat_date
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
HourlyRevenueAgg AS (
    SELECT
        h.stat_date,
        h.stat_hour,
        SUM(CASE WHEN r.event_hour <= h.stat_hour THEN r.revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) AS cumulative_revenue_usd
    FROM ObservedHours h
    LEFT JOIN RevenueByHour r ON h.stat_date = r.stat_date
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    h.stat_date AS "日期",
    LPAD(CAST(h.stat_hour AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || ':00' AS "小时",
    u.cumulative_new_users AS "累计新增角色",
    u.cumulative_active_users AS "累计活跃用户",
    u.cumulative_payers AS "累计付费用户",
    ROUND(r.cumulative_revenue_usd, 2) AS "累计流水USD"
FROM HourlyUserAgg u
INNER JOIN HourlyRevenueAgg r
  ON u.stat_date = r.stat_date
 AND u.stat_hour = r.stat_hour
INNER JOIN ObservedHours h
  ON u.stat_date = h.stat_date
 AND u.stat_hour = h.stat_hour
ORDER BY 1, h.stat_hour;
